notes:
- StitchFits now has a Windows Setup EXE with a Start menu shortcut, optional desktop shortcut, Open With support for .sftx projects, and an uninstall entry in Windows Settings.
- Installed and portable copies use the existing in-app update channel. Setup installs for your Windows account. Updates verify the download, replace the application in its existing folder, and keep a rollback copy. Installed preferences are stored separately.
- Closed Satin supports Density Fade and Color Fade with multiple straight or curved guides. Guided gradients use project format 55.
- Digitizing Lab remains available as an optional download from Design > Digitizing Lab.
